 5. What factor in this client’s history is consistent with risk for 
acute pancreatitis?
Alcohol usage is a risk factor for acute pancreatitis. Obesity 
is also considered a risk factor, but Mr. Cowan has a BMI of 
26 (overweight) currently and was as high as 28.5 when he
weighed 210 pounds. His history of overweight could play 
a role in the development of pancreatitis. Biliary stones are
also a risk factor for acute pancreatitis.
